description: This file defines a template class Deep_ptr that manages deep copying of objects using unique_ptr, including constructors, assignment operators, and comparison operators. It also provides factory functions for creating Deep_ptr instances.

classes.name: Deep_ptr
classes.description: A smart pointer class that performs deep copying of objects, supporting copy and move semantics.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying object.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the pointer to access the object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the raw pointer managed by Deep_ptr.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the managed object to a new raw pointer or null.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps the managed objects of two Deep_ptr instances.
